name: What is the cost of custom framing for an addition in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of custom framing for an addition in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of custom framing for an addition in the Bay Area depends on several factors, including the size of the addition, its complexity, materials chosen, and current labor rates. Generally, framing costs can range from $25 to $45 per square foot, but this is a broad estimate. It's crucial to obtain a detailed quote after an on-site assessment and review of plans. This quote will cover lumber, labor, and necessary fasteners. We provide transparent estimates to help you budget effectively for your project.
